tested_scope.model: One immutable verified successor S binding effect_id E and payload_hash H(P); one externally readable role-local publication target K=f(E); create-only application; exact readback/hash verification; optional applied marker; crash/restart may occur at the three specified boundaries.
application_protocol: Verify immutable successor S and H(P) before any application attempt.
Derive exactly one canonical publication target K from effect_id E, not from attempt number or wall-clock time.
Apply only with create-only semantics. On create success, exact-read K and require H(readback_payload)=H(P).

If create reports already-exists or the prior call outcome is unknown, read K. Identical effect_id and payload hash means the effect is already applied and the retry is a semantic no-op; any mismatch fails closed.
An applied marker is bookkeeping only and cannot authorize the effect; K plus verified payload hash is the durable application fact.
invariants: At most one canonical publication object can exist for an effect_id under protocol-conforming create-only storage.
No application occurs before durable successor verification.
A same-payload retry converges on the same K and cannot create a second canonical effect.
A stale or conflicting payload for the same effect_id cannot overwrite K and is rejected after hash mismatch.
Unknown transport outcome is resolved by next-invocation readback, not same-run wait, poll, or backoff.

finite_symbolic_traces.result: one durable publication effect; reconstructible from S; no exactly-once executor required
no duplicate publication; K is the application fact and marker loss is harmless

finite_symbolic_traces.counterfactual_conflict: If K exists with a different payload hash for the same effect_id, the protocol fails closed and does not overwrite.
finite_symbolic_traces.result: duplicate retry is idempotent in the tested publication model

probe_result: The prior successor-precommit mechanism is sufficient to remove an exactly-once executor for one class of externally meaningful effect: create-only canonical publication keyed by stable effect_id with payload-hash verification. Durable-before-apply plus read-before-retry converts crash ambiguity into reconstructible state. The applied marker is not a correctness dependency.
mechanism_revision: Use an idempotency-keyed canonical effect target as the externally observable state. Treat durable verified successor data as intent, the canonical create-only target as the application fact, and any later marker as derived bookkeeping. Retry by read/verify, never by blind re-emit.
scope_guard: Positive evidence is limited to a single effect_id, one immutable successor, one create-only canonical target with readable exact contents, deterministic payload hashing, and protocol-conforming consumers that define the effect by canonical target state. Mutable append/send/increment effects, non-readable targets, targets lacking create-if-absent semantics, multi-target transactions, and effects whose first attempt can cause an irreversible side effect before durable target state exists remain unresolved.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded role-local create/read persistence only; no hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact service, package service, cloud compute, external API/model, or paid credit is required
mechanism_assessment.accepted_scope: idempotent create-only canonical publication effect across the three finite crash/restart traces
mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: Many useful Chat outcomes expose a mutable canonical pointer such as LATEST rather than only an immutable effect object. Test a two-object immutable-artifact plus compare-and-swap pointer-promotion protocol across crash windows and stale-writer contention without assuming exactly-once execution.

conflict_check: Semantic inputs were limited to the frozen sanitized root, the exact neuroscience role config, and own neuroscience LATEST/preflight. No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, other-role receipt/config, protected-primary, hosted-compute, finite-credit, paid, or manual-user-execution semantics were consumed.
exact_next_action: Next valid invocation: checkpoint first, then test exactly one two-object publication state machine: immutable content-addressed artifact A plus mutable canonical pointer L updated by compare-and-swap from predecessor identity to A. Stress crash after A before L, crash after L before local confirmation, duplicate promotion, and stale competing writer. Accept only if observable latest-state publication is idempotent or fail closed with zero residual richer-mode/protected/manual-user execution, zero finite monthly quota, zero incremental cost, and no same-run wait/poll/backoff.
